_comment: Every assumption the cashflow calculator uses. Edit freely - scripts never hardcode these.

insurance._note: used only when insurance_monthly is not provided; overridable with a real quote

property_tax._note: used ONLY when property_tax_monthly is absent; always prefer the real county figure

dscr._method_note: noi = NOI / annual debt service (capex excluded unless toggled). rent_over_pitia = gross rent / (P&I + tax + insurance + HOA), the DSCR-lender convention Kevin's app uses (shows 2.12).
